scenes.setting: Still in the dark bedroom: the dream was a real spirit-world revelation from a high existence, the paper crane merely a locator — Klein resolves to stay out of it, then divines Will Auceptin's location twice and finds it overlapping with Aaron himself; the crane is swapped for his own cruder forgery
scenes.text_anchor: Will Auceptin’s position overlaps with that of Dr. Aaron…

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog with the real paper crane (visions only: Will Auceptin propped at a dark window, tarot cards in both hands, wooden blocks laid out as a head-to-tail Ouroboros, running water outside): the Snake of Mercury means fate — and the officials can have this one
scenes.text_anchor: That Ouroboros-like snake is indeed the Snake of Mercury?

scenes.setting: In his own dream, the Book of Secrets becomes Ladies Aesthetic as a gray-coated Nightmare walks in — not the Captain. The Nighthawk team leader 'casually' asks about Aaron, learns of the paper crane, bows and vanishes; Klein sits on alone in the dream. 'How nostalgic…'
